Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring driver licensing agents to question the citizenship of voter registration applicants.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to voter registration at driver licensing offices;and amending RCW 46.20.155.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 46.20.155 and 2001 c 41 s 14 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Before issuing an original license or identification card orrenewing a license or identification card under this chapter, thelicensing agent shall determine if the applicant wants to register tovote or transfer his or her voter registration by asking the followingquestions: First: "Do you want to register to vote or transfer your voterregistration?" ((If the applicant chooses to register or transfer a registration,the agent shall state the following: "I would like to remind you that you must be)) Second: "Are you aUnited States citizen and at least eighteen years of age ((in order tovote.))?" p. 1 SB 5701 If the applicant responds in the affirmative the agent shall thenprovide the applicant with a voter registration form and instructionsand shall record that the applicant has requested to register to voteor transfer a voter registration.
